resource.title: The Mary Ladky Teen Award
resource.description: The Mary Ladky Teen Award is a mentorship program at The Children’s Book Bank for high school students. Award recipients will complete an intensive eight-week summer mentorship at one of our four Book Bank locations where they will support with literacy programs, outreach events, and book donations. Students will gain valuable experience working with literacy experts, educators, and authors. With the support of a mentor, recipients will develop and implement a project to support literacy in their communities during Fall 2026. They will present the results of their projects at The Children’s Book Bank Story Soirée in November. Honorarium: $2500 Deadline to apply: June 9

requirements.eligibility: Must be a high school student in the 2026-2027 school year
requirements.documents_required: To apply, please submit a resume and a brief essay (1-2 pages) answering the following questions: Why is reading important? Why is it important to have access to books? How has a book impacted your life? What do you hope to gain from this mentorship? Applications should be submitted to info@childrensbookbank.com with the subject line Mary Ladky Teen Award. Deadline to submit is June 9.
